bug_semantics: The MCP ReplServer creates an Express POST /execute route with no authentication. The handler accepts a JSON code string, wraps it in ExecuteCodePluginTask, and sends it through PluginBridge.executePluginTask, so the supplied JavaScript executes in the MCP process. ReplServer.start originally called app.listen(this.port) without a host; Node/Express therefore listened on the unspecified/all-interfaces address rather than loopback. An unauthenticated adjacent-network client able to reach port 4403 could execute arbitrary code with the MCP process's filesystem, environment, command-execution, and availability privileges. Merely securing the main PenpotMcpServer listener did not secure this separate Express listener.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable behavior originated in the former first-party penpot/penpot-mcp repository at 8552bb4183fc1479c8436c1ccec2868ea221d498 (Add REPL server): that one focused commit first created ReplServer.ts, the unauthenticated /execute route, and app.listen(this.port) without a host. Its parent ad771ee92fbbf36b2d3b515e1a16e551a39cc986 has no ReplServer.ts. Later source commits moved the inline HTML, changed REPL presentation, and changed configuration/logging but retained both security-relevant behaviors. Penpot commit 880b9b61c41f977f4ddf8463ab6ab62194acb077 is a 30,118-line aggregate import whose commit object identifies source repository https://github.com/penpot/penpot-mcp and imported tip fcfa67e908fc54e23a3a3543dee432472dc90c5d; c14ccc18b8c50f21bd581fc662503ac5444df0cf then imported the same vulnerable ReplServer blob into the release line. Those import commits are not the smallest BIC and were decomposed through the referenced source history.
ai_marker: none: `git cat-file commit 8552bb4183fc1479c8436c1ccec2868ea221d498` contains only tree, parent, human author `Dominik Jain <dominik.jain@outlook.com>`, human committer `Dominik Jain <dominik.jain@oraios-ai.de>`, and subject `Add REPL server`; it has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, AI tool attribution, or other AI marker. The company email domain text `oraios-ai.de` is not a generation disclosure or bot identity.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/penpot/penpot/security/advisories/GHSA-22qr-rp27-j9wm states that ReplServer listens on all interfaces at port 4403, /execute performs PluginBridge.executePluginTask with no authentication, the impact is unauthenticated RCE, and 2.15.0 is patched. The assigned bundle records npm @penpot/mcp vulnerable range < 2.15.0 and first patched version 2.15.0.

In the validated penpot clone, `git cat-file commit 880b9b61c41f977f4ddf8463ab6ab62194acb077` says `Original repository: https://github.com/penpot/penpot-mcp` and `Imported commit: fcfa67e908fc54e23a3a3543dee432472dc90c5d`. `git show --stat 880b9...` shows a 70-file, 30,118-insertion aggregate, including a new ReplServer.ts, so 880b9 is an import boundary rather than the smallest original write.

In a read-only temporary clone of that named source repository, `git log fcfa67e908fc54e23a3a3543dee432472dc90c5d --follow -- mcp-server/src/ReplServer.ts` returns, oldest first, 8552bb4183fc1479c8436c1ccec2868ea221d498 (Add REPL server), 3a1494e18cba059d1d9fb8b2fcdfa88b05a8e749 (move HTML), 3da2065a189a6cd4aebb31c78663cc865d2a486f (REPL history/outputs), and 055f7172075a2b4ca320d9867cb3be6909c4dd8e (environment configuration). `git merge-base --is-ancestor 8552bb4 fcfa67e` exits 0.

Source `git show 8552bb4183fc1479c8436c1ccec2868ea221d498 -- mcp-server/src/ReplServer.ts` shows a new 331-line file containing both `this.app.post("/execute", ...)`, construction/execution of ExecuteCodePluginTask from request code, and `this.server = this.app.listen(this.port, () => {`. `git log -L '/this.server = this.app.listen/',+1:mcp-server/src/ReplServer.ts fcfa67e...` attributes that listen line to 8552bb4, and `git log --all -S'this.app.listen(this.port, () =>' -- mcp-server/src/ReplServer.ts` returns only 8552bb4.

Direct parent verification: `git cat-file commit 8552bb4...` names parent ad771ee92fbbf36b2d3b515e1a16e551a39cc986, and `git ls-tree -r ad771ee92fbbf36b2d3b515e1a16e551a39cc986 -- mcp-server/src/ReplServer.ts` produces no entry. The file and therefore both the exposed route and unsafe listener are absent in the immediate parent.

Import identity is byte-exact: source `git rev-parse fcfa67e...:mcp-server/src/ReplServer.ts` and penpot `git rev-parse 880b9...:mcp/packages/server/src/ReplServer.ts` and `git rev-parse c14ccc...:mcp/packages/server/src/ReplServer.ts` all return blob 978f0e2ea4f97fcc9d4836c4f07b2bb31a89bcd9. Thus c14ccc18b8c50f21bd581fc662503ac5444df0cf did not independently author the flaw; it carried the decomposed source history into the Penpot 2.13 release line.

Release-line boundary: `git rev-parse '2.13.0^{commit}' '2.13.1^{commit}'` returns 7d09d930fe00cb94987a7d622a668ee81984ba02 and d979894872b5bf728db94f84aa3ad4b9fdee33d1. `git cat-file -e 2.13.0:mcp/packages/server/src/ReplServer.ts` fails while the same command at 2.13.1 succeeds; c14ccc's parent is exactly 7d09d... . `git show 2.14.5:mcp/packages/server/src/ReplServer.ts` still shows unauthenticated /execute and app.listen(this.port) with no host.

The similar-listener remediation was incomplete. `git show 0027e9031a25e43eb2087cecf9d3892644aec35c` passes a configured host to PenpotMcpServer's own app.listen but only changes ReplServer's displayed URL; its actual call remains app.listen(this.port). `git log -S'PENPOT_MCP_SERVER_HOST ?? "localhost"' -- PenpotMcpServer.ts` finds the later localhost-default work, including 4e3dc6532a314f3411b193a4e40b3a8b98adad9b, while ReplServer remained separately exposed, matching the advisory's missed-server account.

Direct fix: `git show 798ee46b4a84ee6dfc756b001f33acbe0280d62f` adds ReplServer.host, defaults it to `localhost`, forwards PenpotMcpServer.this.host at the call site, and changes the vulnerable call to `this.app.listen(this.port, this.host, ...)`; its commit message explicitly describes unauthenticated RCE. Its sole parent 697a825d76c5d7bd8b28a57b0d4be049a91f2455 still has the no-host listen call, so 798ee46 is the direct closing fix rather than a release-only carrier.

Fixed-version ancestry: tag commits are 2.14.5=df01f7605629a3176755faf28428627ef186e0dc and 2.15.0=bd3ca6f8e56869a18731544099c35bd4ab2824b6. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 798ee46 2.14.5` exits 1 and the same check for 2.15.0 exits 0. The fix is absent from 2.15.0-RC4 (1e1ca82ba53780bf7dcacf6c3fc46dba2f26aae6) and present by 2.15.0-RC5 (e9588f3939d3e3e0e2017309962a4d1282e333b6). `git show 2.15.0:mcp/packages/server/src/ReplServer.ts` shows the host-aware listen call, confirming the advisory's stable 2.15.0 boundary.

BIC-only AI check: the raw 8552bb4183fc1479c8436c1ccec2868ea221d498 commit object has author Dominik Jain <dominik.jain@outlook.com>, committer Dominik Jain <dominik.jain@oraios-ai.de>, and only the message `Add REPL server`; no trailers or bot/generated markers appear. Import, partial-fix, fix, PR, and branch metadata were excluded from the AI judgment.
reasoning: The real security boundary is the combination of an inherently dangerous unauthenticated code-execution route and an unintended all-interface listener. Both first appear together in the focused source commit 8552bb4; the immediate parent lacks the entire file. The large Penpot import commits merely preserve the exact source blob and are therefore rejected as BICs after decomposition. Subsequent refactors and the fix for the main MCP listener did not remove the ReplServer attack path. Commit 798ee46 closes the network exposure by binding this listener to the configured host, defaulting to localhost, and is present in stable 2.15.0 but absent from 2.14.5. Because the BIC commit object contains no qualifying AI attribution or bot identity, the evidence supports NOT_AI rather than either AI verdict.
